title: Write CONTRIBUTING.md
description: Create CONTRIBUTING.md with instructions for local development, testing, adding templates, adding backends, PR guidelines, and code style.
acceptanceCriteria: How to clone and build locally section is present
How to run tests section is present
How to add a new template section is present
How to add a new backend section is present

steps.details: Create CONTRIBUTING.md with sections: # Contributing to Rocket CLI, ## Development Setup (clone, npm install, npm run dev), ## Running Tests (npm test), ## Adding a New Template, ## Adding a New Backend, ## Pull Request Guidelines, ## Code Style.
Explain: create src/templates/<name>/ directory, add template files with {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens, update the scaffold.ts templateName union type, update NewProjectWizard TUI options.
Explain: implement AgentBackend interface in src/lib/backends/<name>.ts, add to getBackend() selector in index.ts, add CLI flag in Commander registration, update docs.
